description: National Address Database is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. National Address Database This National Geospatial Data Asset (NGDA) dataset, shared as a U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT) feature layer, displays address data in the United States. Per USDOT, "The U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT) and its partners from all levels of government recognize the need for a National Address Database (NAD). Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri U.S. Federal Datasets. Its keywords are NAD, National Address Database, federal, buildings, structures, address, USDOT, U.S. Department of Transportation. The bounding box given is -166.5914,18.3092,-64.6625,65.2916. The hub shows 2026-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Please refer to the U.S. Department of Transportation website for information on the National Address Database (NAD) Disclaimer .. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
